name: patternlike-app
description: Pattern-Like Astrology App monorepo — Cloudflare-first, Swiss Ephemeris calculation authority

scripts.//build: @patternlike/web builds BEFORE @patternlike/api: the api build is a production dry-run deploy, and [env.production.assets] reads apps/web/dist, which must already exist.
scripts.test: npm run test -w @patternlike/shared -w @patternlike/reading-engine -w @patternlike/pattern-engine -w @patternlike/calc-stub -w @patternlike/codex-runner -w @patternlike/ontology-signer -w @patternlike/api -w @patternlike/web && npm run test:content && npm run test:contracts
scripts.//test:content: Editorial candidate gate. Node test runner, no workspace: the builder is repository tooling and the candidates are review material, not shipped code.
scripts.test:contracts: npm run test:spec-renderers && python contracts/validate_schemas.py && python contracts/m0/smoke_check.py && python contracts/smoke_check.py
scripts.//ci:local: GitHub Actions is unavailable on this account and main is not branch protected. This runs the same steps as .github/workflows/ci.yml, on the .nvmrc Node, and prints a paste-ready summary. It is the merge gate.
scripts.deploy:api: npm run build -w @patternlike/web && npm run deploy -w @patternlike/api
